prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Create a FINISHED display advertisement supplied by an independent advertiser, not a photograph for a web page, not a website component or card. The finished raster includes its own complete brand identity, campaign typography, artwork, persuasive copy and a prominent call-to-action drawn into the advertisement. All requested Italian wording must be exact and highly legible. Professional real-world ad agency art direction. Use only the brief's copy; no fake prices, discounts, deadlines or added claims. No weather-site branding or shared weather palette. No outer frame or watermark. Make the entire canvas the single ad; no grid of options, no mockup screen.
Format: LEADERBOARD 728×90, very wide and shallow ratio 8.09:1. Generate a VERY WIDE HORIZONTAL STRIP canvas, not a 3:2 image. The ad must work at only 90px tall.
Input image 1: flat illustration subject reference for the café cups and croissant.
Creative concept: bold flat graphic design school campaign; no photograph, no physical paper moodboards. Saturated warm yellow background, black typography and punchy magenta blocks. Left compact brand; center an oversized simple headline; right a strong black rectangular CTA with white text. Between brand and headline, show three small side-by-side interpretations of the same espresso cup (classic engraved brown, flat terracotta, retro pixel green), demonstrating visual languages in one thin strip. Deliberate high contrast editorial art direction, feels like a completely different advertiser from a university or a café.
Text verbatim: brand "ATLANTE DELLE INTERFACCE"; headline "Stesso contenuto. Nuove forme."; CTA "Esplora i progetti". Keep copy to one or two lines max. Large legible type filling the shallow format; no extra slogan or text.
rights: Creatività originale del laboratorio; non è una campagna commerciale o istituzionale ufficiale. Originale conservato, testo pubblicitario incluso nell’immagine; nome accessibile e destinazione in HTML.
